sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Prem Chand   with petition  versus  THE STATE (GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI) & ANR.
 Through: Mr. Hemant Mehl  with SI Hario  Shahdara  Mr. Tabussan   R2 in person.
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TUSHAR RAO GEDELA  ORDER % 18.12.2023 1.

This is a petition under Section 482 CrPC 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No. 87/2019 dated 17.04.2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC,1860 registered at P.S. Shahdara, Delhi and all the other proceedings emanating therefrom on the basis of settlement having been arrived at between the parties.

2. Learned counsel for the parties submits that the disputes have been amicably resolved and the terms of settlement have been reduced in writing vide settlement dated 01.05.2023 under the aegis of the Counselling Cell, Family Court, North-East District, Karkardooma Court.

entities.text: Counselling Cell, Family Court, North-East District, Karkardooma Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The copy of the settlement deed is annexed to the present petition as Annexure P3 at page 3.
According to the terms of the settlement, both the parties have agreed to settle their differences and give another chance to their marriage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Court has interacted with the respondent no. 2, who is present in person.
She submits that she is now happy in her marriage and is residing with her husband since 01.05.2023 alongwith her two minor children.

She submits that she has no further disputes and that the petitioner husband has been cooperating with her and carrying out all the responsibilities as a husband.
6.

The petitioner husband also submits that they have resolved all their differences and are living happily and as such also assures the Court that there will be no reason for any complaint qua the respondent no. 2.
7.
The IO is present in person who identifies the parties.

8. Keeping in view the fact that the parties have been able to resolve their disputes and residing together as husband and wife, this Court is of the considered opinion that no purpose will be served in continuing the aforesaid FIR alongwith all other criminal proceedings emanating therefrom.
9. In fact the continuation of the same would be deleterious to the existence of the marriage between the parties and their happy family.
As such, the FIR No. 87/2019 dated 17.04.2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC 1860 registered at P.S. Shahdara, Delhi and all the other proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
10. In view of the above, the petition stands disposed of.
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J DECEMBER 18, 2023/
N.S. ASWAL
